description: Global proper-name pronunciation lexicon (issue #1). Canonical spelling is NEVER changed in scripts, metadata or captions; this file only decides how each TTS engine renders a name.

fields.original: exact canonical spelling as in the script (case-sensitive match, whole word)
fields.lang: language of origin of the NAME (ISO 639)
fields.IPA_if_verified: IPA ONLY when taken from a cited reference (never invented); null otherwise
fields.ipa_source: URL + exact entry/location for the IPA
fields.vi_established_form: established Vietnamese written form, if any (e.g. Niu-tơn)
fields.tts: per-engine rendering: {engine_family: {mode: phonemes|respell|as_is, value, derived_from}}; experimental=true marks a composed, unverified candidate (test reels only)
fields.pronunciation_language: language/variant of the cited pronunciation actually used (e.g. 'en-US' for an English reading of an Italian surname); may differ from lang
fields.provisional: true = approved by a blanket user decision without per-name listening; revisit when the user listens

statuses.PENDING_RESEARCH: no verified reference yet — blocks full synthesis
statuses.UNRESOLVED: no reliable reference exists — blocks full synthesis until an editorial decision is recorded
statuses.TTS_CANDIDATE: rendering chosen from a verified reference; not yet listened — usable only for --proof/test renders
statuses.NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: in an A/B reel awaiting a listener — usable only for --proof/test renders
statuses.LISTENED_OK: human listener approved in context — the only status accepted for production renders

conventions: Established Vietnamese forms (e.g. Niu-tơn, Anh-xtanh in textbooks) may be used for narration when documented; otherwise prefer the language-of-origin pronunciation from a cited reference, or a documented audience-friendly form.
Scientific Latin and ancient names have no single correct pronunciation; record the convention chosen (e.g. English academic vs classical) and say so.
IPA stored here is metadata; the engine consumes its own phoneme inventory. 'tts.value' must record what was actually sent to the engine and how it was derived from the IPA.
Never infer IPA from memory or from TTS output. If no reference: UNRESOLVED.
Every rendering is verified by an A/B listening reel in context before full episode synthesis.

Listener decision 2026-10-15 (reel v2): the engine's own reading (variant A) was preferred over cited-IPA candidates (C/D) and Vietnamese respellings (B) for all 14 names tested. For new names, test A first; add a cited-IPA candidate only where A is clearly wrong (e.g. letters spelled out). Rejected candidates are kept under 'alternatives'.
2026-10-15: until the user says otherwise, new names default to the engine reading (A) as provisional LISTENED_OK (blanket user decision).
2026-10-15: user listened to H001 and confirmed engine-default name readings; new names keep the engine reading (A) unless a listener flags one.
